interest: Indexes 1940-44 US intelligence on Japanese aviation: the Zero fighter, aircraft exports, raw-material shortages, and German-Japanese aircraft barter talks.
overview: Docket sheets (1940-44) for file 894.248 on Japanese aviation: attempted US aircraft exports, Zero fighter intelligence, China combat losses, raw-material shortages, and Matsuoka's Berlin barter talks for German aircraft technology.

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet (Form DS-46) recording file entries 34 and 35 regarding proposed and compliance-related exports of aviation equipment and airplanes to Japan in early 1940.
subfiles.summary: Lists entries 34-35: Eclipse Aviation's shipments to Japan, and a Curtiss-Wright agent's bid to sell planes to Japan via Havana.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Decimal File 894.248 (Sub-numbers 34-35)

subfiles.about: State Department purport sheet listing intelligence reports and correspondence on Japanese air operations, aircraft production, and foreign procurement from May 1940 to April 1942.
subfiles.summary: Lists entries 36-48: Japanese air losses in China, Zero fighter data, aluminum shortages, and Matsuoka's Berlin aircraft talks.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Decimal File 894.248, Sheet #6 (Sub-numbers 36-48 1/2)

subfiles.about: State Department purport sheet indexing intelligence reports, export valuations, and Allied assessments of Japanese air strength from July 1942 to March 1944.
subfiles.summary: Lists entries 49-52: improved Zero fighter design, prewar export license data, British reports on Japanese air strength, and aircraft-position estimates.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Decimal File 894.248, Sheet #7 (Sub-numbers 49-52)
